notes: Fires when the user asks to review already-written code or a diff for a feature; produces docs/reviews/REVIEW-<feature>-<date>.md with a PASS/FAIL verdict. Boundary separates it from the checklist reference when no concrete code is named.

evals.prompt: Review the code for the payment feature — check security, correctness, and performance.
evals.expected_output: Detects tech stack from CLAUDE.md/PROJECT.md, reviews the payment implementation by dimension (security/correctness/framework standards), and writes docs/reviews/REVIEW-payment-<YYYYMMDD>.md with per-finding file+line refs and a clear PASS/FAIL verdict.

evals.prompt: Can you do a code review on the order module I just implemented? Flag anything blocking before I open a PR.
evals.expected_output: Reads the order-module source (and any DEV work log), reviews against the security/correctness dimensions, and produces docs/reviews/REVIEW-order-<date>.md with Critical/Major/Minor findings and a PASS/FAIL verdict per the decision rules.

evals.prompt: What should I look for when reviewing pull requests? Give me a code review checklist to apply.
evals.expected_output: Should route to code-review-checklist / not fire, because no specific code, diff, or feature is named to review — the user wants the reusable checklist reference, not an active review that produces a REVIEW artifact and verdict.
